node: Healthcare licensure and hybrid campus capacity
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around healthcare licensure and hybrid campus capacity. The strongest public-market mapping is not pure online content delivery; it clusters around operators that can manage regulated healthcare programs, campus/lab utilization, clinical placement, simulation technology, employer pipelines, and certification-linked workforce pathways. LOPE is kept as the reference anchor because the supplied evidence directly ties its hybrid ABSN/OTA growth to simulation technology, virtual reality, clinical/prerequisite strategy, and state-specific licensure requirements. The underfollowed discovery lane adds ATGE, UTI, and LRN as smaller/mid-cap public assets with healthcare workforce education exposure, though each requires later verification of clinical-placement capacity, licensure pass rates, regulatory approvals, and segment-level economics.
